name: Kagami Sara
source: The student representative, one of the strongest swordsmen of all time due to her family that has produced countless talented swordsmen. She is a serious girl respected and feared by everyone around her, and she hates wicked people. She treasures her younger sister Hotaru since her family mocked her for her lack of talent.
